The Deq shapes for Python.

A port of the `@0xdolan/deq-core` reference renderer that produces the same SVG byte for
byte (ADR 0008), plus the core export formats and the `deq` command line tool.

```python
from deq_shapes import render
svg = render("roj-half-sun", {"size": 48, "color": "#ED2024", "params": {"rays": 9}})
```

Source: [`python/deq-shapes`](../../python/deq-shapes/). Install with `pip install deq-shapes`; every name below is importable from `deq_shapes`.

The shape description of a composition: one `use` per part, each on its own layer.

### `decode_leet`

```python
def decode_leet(svg: str, options: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> DecodedLeet
```

Read the text back from Leet SVG written by `leet` at the `basic` level.

`options` must be the render options used to write it. The SVG is treated as text and
only matched against what `leet` writes.

**Raises** `DeqError`: `INVALID_OPTIONS` when the input is not Deq Leet SVG, or
`LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (input over `MAX_DECODE_INPUT`, more than
`MAX_GLYPHS` glyphs).

### `leet`

```python
def leet(text: str, options: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> LeetResult
```

Write `text` with Deq glyphs.

The input is plain text: length-capped, normalised and never parsed as markup.
Characters without a glyph are left out and listed in `unknown`; Sorani runs right to
left. Options are `level`, `script`, `seed`, `letterSpacing`, `lineSpacing`,
`align`, `colors` and the render options except the per-shape ones.

**Raises** `DeqError`: `INVALID_OPTIONS` (also when nothing is left to draw) or
`LIMIT_EXCEEDED`.

### `normalize`

```python
def normalize(text: str, script: Script) -> Normalized
```

Normalise `text` for `script`: NFC, LF, no joiners or tatweel, upper case, aliases.

**Raises** `DeqError`: `LIMIT_EXCEEDED` for input over `MAX_INPUT`, more than
`MAX_GLYPHS` glyphs or more than `MAX_LINES` lines.

### `pattern`

```python
def pattern(options: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> PatternResult
```

Generate a pattern of Deq motifs.

`band` repeats motifs in a row (alternating or mirrored), `grid` lays a checkerboard,
`rosette` rings petals round a centre and `border` frames a rectangle. Options are
`kind`, `seed`, `motifs`, `count`, `cols`, `rows`, `petals`, `spacing`,
`colors` and the render options except the per-shape ones.

**Raises** `DeqError`: `INVALID_OPTIONS`, `UNKNOWN_SHAPE` or `LIMIT_EXCEEDED`.

## Classes

### `Cell`

```python
class Cell
```

One glyph placed in a scene; its 24 x 24 cell has its top left at (x, y).

- `x: float`
- `y: float`
- `glyph: Glyph`

### `DecodedLeet`

```python
class DecodedLeet
```

The result of `decode_leet`.

- `text: str`: The text; glyphs that are not basic glyphs read as U+FFFD.
- `script: Script`
- `unmatched: int`: How many glyph groups were not basic glyphs of the table.

### `DeqError`

```python
class DeqError(Exception)
```

Why an operation failed. `code` is stable; the message is for people.

### `LeetResult`

```python
class LeetResult
```

The result of `leet`.

- `svg: str`: The SVG document, one `<g data-layer="cN">` per glyph in reading order.
- `text: str`: The normalised text that was drawn.
- `script: Script`
- `level: LeetLevel`
- `unknown: tuple[str, ...]`: Input characters with no glyph, in first-seen order (they are left out).
- `scene: Scene`

### `PatternResult`

```python
class PatternResult
```

The result of `pattern`.

- `svg: str`: The SVG document, one `<g data-layer="cN">` per motif.
- `motifs: tuple[str, ...]`: The motifs chosen, in the order the pattern uses them.
- `scene: Scene`

### `Prepared`

```python
class Prepared
```

A shape ready to draw: resolved options and flat geometry in canvas units.

- `options: ResolvedOptions`
- `items: tuple[g.Flat, ...]`
- `layers: tuple[str, ...]`: The layer ids of the shape, in declaration order.
- `default_title: str`: The title used when `options.title` is not set (the English name).

### `Random`

```python
class Random
```

A deterministic stream of unsigned 32-bit integers.

- `next() -> int`: The next unsigned 32-bit integer.
- `below(n: int) -> int`: An integer in `0 .. n - 1` (`n` >= 1).
- `pick(items: Sequence[_T]) -> _T`: One element of a non-empty sequence.

### `ResolvedOptions`

```python
class ResolvedOptions
```

Options after validation, with every default filled in.

- `size: float = 24`
- `color: str = 'currentColor'`
- `stroke_width: float = 2`
- `absolute_stroke_width: bool = False`
- `fill: str = 'none'`
- `fill_opacity: float = 1`
- `stroke_opacity: float = 1`
- `linecap: Literal['round', 'butt', 'square'] = 'round'`
- `linejoin: Literal['round', 'miter', 'bevel'] = 'round'`
- `dot_scale: float = 1`
- `rotation: float = 0`
- `flip_x: bool = False`
- `flip_y: bool = False`
- `padding: float = 0`
- `background: str = 'none'`
- `layer_colors: Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)`
- `title: str | None = None`
- `aria_label: str | None = None`
- `params: Mapping[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)`

### `Scene`

```python
class Scene
```

Glyphs on a `width` x `height` canvas in grid units.

- `width: float`
- `height: float`
- `cells: tuple[Cell, ...]`

### `SvgHooks`

```python
class SvgHooks
```

Hooks for `svg_document`, used by exporters that need named layer groups.

- `root_attrs: str = ''`: Extra attributes on the root `<svg>`, starting with a space.
- `layer_attrs: Callable[[str], str] | None = None`: Extra attributes for the group of a layer, starting with a space. When given, every layer gets its own group and the rotation/flip transform moves onto each group.
